gen-gf-gajraj-one-fs-karma: Karma brings a classic serif steadiness, its terminals finishing clear of the stem and its strokes modulating gently, under Gajraj One's fat black stems and hairline threads. Gajraj One earns its place big and brief.
gen-gf-geist-mono-fs-ranade: Precise and structured, Geist Mono draws every stroke as a plain, unshaded line that never swells. Ranade below it is looser, with a slight tug of heavier verticals against lighter horizontals and stroke ends set far apart.
gen-gf-gideon-roman-fs-rowan: Rowan, a text serif with generous openings in every curve, sits beneath Gideon Roman, whose c opens like a pair of calipers. The thin parts of Rowan stay only slightly slimmer than its stems.
gen-gf-goblin-one-fs-karma: Fat stems like cut ribbon stand beside hairlines like thread in Goblin One, a heading with a strong pull between heavy and slender. Karma then reads steadily, its strokes varying in weight but only a little.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-alpino: Tall and cozy, the body text of Alpino makes its ascenders look short and keeps its curve endings well apart. Goldman above it spreads its letters wide, and its round forms look like open parentheses; a generous heading size lets that width breathe.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-paquito: Confident from the first line, Goldman spaces its wide letters with plenty of clearance and a big lowercase. And Paquito, a classic serif with barely any gap between x-height and caps, keeps a long passage approachable.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-ranade: Commanding Goldman spreads its wide letters with generous clearance, while Ranade follows in a sans with slight but noticeable stroke contrast. The strongest quality here is the gap between a wide, bold heading and a softly organic body.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-lisu-bosa: Lisu Bosa reads sturdy and large, its tall lowercase letting counters spill into the space around them. Goldman's wide, bold capitals above it have low contrast, while the text serif below carries a medium amount.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-strait: Wide, bold and round-cornered, a big lowercase leading the way. Goldman's generous letterspacing meets Strait, a plain sans with big round bowls, and the strongest quality is how approachable that makes the pair.
gen-gf-graduate-fs-ranade: Graduate draws its rounded-rod letters in a single weight, each one standing alone with space around it and curves that sweep open. Ranade brings quiet variation in line weight inside each letter, and Graduate earns its keep big and short.
